items.title: EU leaders gather for first ever AI summit
items.description: The summit comes as worries about the artificial intelligence's global impact mount and Europe seeks a role in its development and regulation.

items.title: Germany news: Parliament agrees on debt-laden 2027 budget
items.description: The budget committee in the Bundestag worked into the night to sign off on next year's spending plans. These include levels of new debt only eclipsed once, at the height of the COVID pandemic. DW has more.

items.title: Can the EU make it harder to trick consumers online?
items.description: The EU wants to curb subscription traps, misleading sales tactics and features that keep people scrolling. What would the proposed Digital Fairness Act change, and does it go far enough?
